meta.purpose: Concept catalogue for a service-catalogue-first front door. Not a live service.
meta.matching: Transparent keyword + alias matching in the browser. No LLM, no network calls.

demo_resident.note: Fictional demo account. In a real service this comes from the identity layer and the line-of-business system — NOT from the service catalogue. The front door composes the two.
demo_resident.name: Rowan Whitfield

services.name: Pay your Council Tax
services.one_line: Make a Council Tax payment or set up a Direct Debit.
services.eligibility: Anyone with a Meadowvale Council Tax account.
you_will_need: A debit card or your bank details

transaction.confirms: Payment of £182.40 taken. Your next instalment is due 1 September 2026.

what_happens_next: Payment shows on your account within 3 working days
Direct Debits are taken on the 1st or 15th of the month
services.source: Meadowvale BC — Pay your Council Tax (reviewed May 2026)

services.name: Tell us you're moving home
services.one_line: Update your Council Tax account when you move within, into or out of Meadowvale.
services.eligibility: Council Tax payers moving on a known date.
you_will_need: Your current address and account number
A forwarding address if you're leaving the area
what_happens_next: We recalculate your bill within 5 working days
We send a revised bill and refund any overpayment on the old property

services.name: Single person discount on Council Tax
services.one_line: Get 25% off if you're the only adult living in your home.
services.eligibility: Households where only one adult (18+) lives, with some exceptions such as students and carers.
you_will_need: Details of everyone living at the address
what_happens_next: We check the details, sometimes against other records
The discount is applied from the date you qualify
services.source: Meadowvale BC — Council Tax discounts (reviewed May 2026)

services.name: Help paying your Council Tax if you're on a low income
services.one_line: Apply for a reduction if you're on a low income or receive certain benefits.
services.eligibility: Depends on your income, savings, household and whether you get qualifying benefits.
you_will_need: Details of everyone in the household
what_happens_next: We assess your claim, usually within 10 working days
We adjust your bill and write to you with the outcome
services.source: Meadowvale BC — Council Tax Reduction (reviewed May 2026)

services.name: Check your Council Tax band
aliases: how much is my council tax
services.one_line: Find out the valuation band for a property, which affects how much Council Tax you pay.
services.eligibility: Any property in England. Bands are set by the Valuation Office Agency (VOA), not the council.
services.fulfilment_detail: Bands are set by the VOA. Check any address at https://www.gov.uk/council-tax-bands
what_happens_next: Use the VOA tool to see the band
If you think a band is wrong, contact the VOA — the council cannot change it
services.source: VOA / Meadowvale BC — Council Tax bands (reviewed May 2026)

services.name: Report a repair in your council home
services.one_line: Report a non-urgent repair if you rent your home from the council.
services.eligibility: Council tenants, and leaseholders for communal repairs.
what_happens_next: We give a target timescale by repair type, usually 5–20 working days
You get an appointment window by text
services.source: Meadowvale BC — Council housing repairs (reviewed Apr 2026)

services.name: Report an emergency repair
services.one_line: Report a repair that's dangerous or makes your home unsafe — loss of heating, water or security.
services.eligibility: Council tenants. If you smell gas, call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 first.
services.fulfilment_detail: Call 01000 800 200 — 24 hours a day, every day
what_happens_next: We aim to make the situation safe within 24 hours
A follow-up repair may be booked for later

services.name: Book your annual gas safety check
services.one_line: Arrange the yearly gas safety inspection that's required in council homes.
services.eligibility: Council tenants with a gas supply.
what_happens_next: Choose an appointment slot
An engineer visits and issues your gas safety record

services.name: Nowhere to sleep tonight
services.one_line: Emergency help if you have nowhere safe to stay tonight.
services.eligibility: Anyone in the Meadowvale area who is homeless or at immediate risk tonight.
you_will_need: A phone number we can call you back on if the line is busy
services.fulfilment_detail: Call the Housing Options duty line on 0800 731 0999 — open 24 hours, free to call
what_happens_next: An officer assesses your situation now
We arrange emergency accommodation if we have a duty to
Out of hours, the same number reaches the standby team

services.name: Get help if you're worried about becoming homeless
services.one_line: Advice and a prevention plan if you're at risk of losing your home in the coming weeks.
services.eligibility: Anyone at risk of homelessness within 56 days; the help you get depends on your circumstances.
you_will_need: Any letters from your landlord or lender
Details of your household and income
services.fulfilment_detail: Book a Housing Options appointment at https://www.meadowvale.gov.uk/housing/options or call 01000 800 300
what_happens_next: We make a personalised housing plan with you
We may contact your landlord to try to prevent the eviction

services.name: Find your bin collection day
services.one_line: Check which days your rubbish, recycling and garden bins are collected.
services.eligibility: Households in Meadowvale. Collection days vary by address.
what_happens_next: Your personal collection calendar is shown
You can add reminders or download it

answer_needs.question: What is your postcode?
answer_needs.why_safe: A postcode identifies a property, not a person. No account, no sign-in, and we do not store it.
answer_needs.not_found: We don't have collection rounds for that postcode — it may be outside Meadowvale.

services.name: Report a missed bin collection
services.one_line: Tell us if your bin was out on time but wasn't emptied.
services.eligibility: Report within 2 working days of your collection day; the bin must have been out by 6:30am.
what_happens_next: If eligible, a crew returns within 2 working days
Leave your bin out until it's emptied

services.name: My bin wasn't collected
services.one_line: Report a bin that wasn't emptied on your collection day.
services.eligibility: Same as reporting a missed collection.
what_happens_next: A crew returns within 2 working days if eligible

services.name: Subscribe to garden waste collection
aliases: how much is the garden bin
services.one_line: Pay for fortnightly collection of garden waste from a green bin.
services.eligibility: Households that want the optional garden waste service.

transaction.confirms: Subscription started. Your green bin will be delivered within 10 working days.

what_happens_next: Your bin is delivered within 10 working days
Collections run fortnightly on your normal collection day
services.invariant_answer: Garden waste collection costs £48 per bin per year, collected fortnightly.
services.source: Meadowvale BC — Garden waste (fees set for 2026/27)

services.name: What can I put in my recycling bin?
services.one_line: The list of materials accepted in your kerbside recycling bin.
services.eligibility: All households with a recycling bin.
services.fulfilment_detail: Yes: paper, card, cardboard, plastic bottles, food tins and drink cans, glass bottles and jars. No: food waste, plastic bags or film, textiles, or electricals. Rinse containers and leave them loose, not bagged.
what_happens_next: Rinse containers and leave them loose — not bagged
If in doubt, put it in general waste so you don't contaminate the load
services.invariant_answer: Yes: paper, card, cardboard, plastic bottles, food tins and drink cans, glass bottles and jars. No: food waste, plastic bags or film, textiles, or electricals.

services.name: Recycling centre (tip) opening hours
services.one_line: Opening hours for the Meadowvale Household Waste Recycling Centre.
services.eligibility: Open to Meadowvale residents. Vans and trailers need a free permit booked in advance.
you_will_need: Proof of address may be requested
services.fulfilment_detail: The Meadowvale Recycling Centre on Quarry Road is open every day 8am–6pm (April–September) and 8am–4pm (October–March), except Christmas Day.
what_happens_next: Book a free van/trailer permit in advance if needed
services.invariant_answer: The Meadowvale Recycling Centre on Quarry Road is open every day 8am–6pm (April–September) and 8am–4pm (October–March), except Christmas Day.

services.name: Book a bulky waste collection
services.one_line: Arrange a paid collection for large items like furniture and appliances.
services.eligibility: Households; up to 5 items per booking.
you_will_need: Somewhere to leave them for collection
known_once_signed_in: Somewhere to leave them for collection

transaction.confirms: Collection booked. Leave your items out by 6:30am on the day.

what_happens_next: Choose a collection date
Leave items out by 6:30am on the day

services.name: Apply for a resident parking permit
services.one_line: Apply to park on-street in a controlled parking zone where you live.
services.eligibility: Depends on your parking zone, your vehicle and proof of residence.
what_happens_next: We check your zone and eligibility
A virtual permit is issued to your registration

answer_needs.question: What is your postcode?
answer_needs.why_safe: Parking zones are set by street and are published. Telling you your zone needs no account.
answer_needs.not_found: That postcode isn't in a controlled parking zone we manage.

MV3 8QT.still_apply: You still need to apply — whether you qualify depends on your vehicle and proof of address.

MV1 2BD.still_apply: You still need to apply — whether you qualify depends on your vehicle and proof of address.

services.name: Pay a parking fine
services.one_line: Pay a Penalty Charge Notice (PCN) issued in Meadowvale.
services.eligibility: Anyone with a PCN reference.

transaction.confirms: Payment taken. The case is now closed.

what_happens_next: Pay within 14 days for the 50% discount
Payment closes the case
services.source: Meadowvale BC — Pay a PCN (reviewed Mar 2026)

services.name: Challenge a parking fine
services.one_line: Tell us why you think a Penalty Charge Notice shouldn't have been issued.
services.eligibility: Anyone with a PCN who wants to make a formal challenge.
you_will_need: Any evidence such as photos or tickets
what_happens_next: We review and respond within 15 working days
The 14-day discount is protected while we consider it
services.source: Meadowvale BC — Challenge a PCN (reviewed Mar 2026)

services.name: Apply for a Blue Badge
services.one_line: Apply for a Blue Badge so you can park closer to where you need to go.
services.eligibility: Depends on your mobility, health conditions or benefits — some people qualify automatically, others are assessed.
you_will_need: Details of your condition or benefits
what_happens_next: We assess your application, sometimes with a mobility assessment
If approved, your badge arrives within 10 working days

services.name: Disabled Facilities Grant (adaptations to your home)
aliases: am i eligible for a disabled facilities grant
services.one_line: Funding to adapt your home if you or someone you live with is disabled.
services.eligibility: Depends on an occupational therapy assessment and a means test — it varies by person and household.
you_will_need: Details of the person who needs adaptations
Information about your income and savings
services.fulfilment_detail: Request an assessment at https://www.meadowvale.gov.uk/housing/adaptations or call 01000 800 400
what_happens_next: An occupational therapist assesses what's needed
We means-test the works and agree a grant if you qualify
services.source: Meadowvale BC — Disabled Facilities Grants (reviewed Mar 2026)

services.name: Register to vote
services.one_line: Add yourself to the electoral register so you can vote in elections.
services.eligibility: British, Irish, EU or qualifying Commonwealth citizens aged 16+ (you can vote at 18).
services.fulfilment_detail: Register free at https://www.gov.uk/register-to-vote — it takes about 5 minutes.
what_happens_next: You get a confirmation from the Electoral Services team
Register by the published deadline before any election
services.invariant_answer: Register to vote for free at gov.uk/register-to-vote. It takes about 5 minutes and you'll need your National Insurance number.
services.source: Meadowvale BC / GOV.UK — Register to vote (reviewed May 2026)

services.name: Report fly-tipping
services.one_line: Report waste that's been dumped illegally on public land.
services.eligibility: Anyone. For dumping on private land we can only advise.
you_will_need: A photo if it's safe to take one
what_happens_next: We aim to clear public-land fly-tipping within 3 working days
We investigate for evidence to prosecute

services.name: Report a noise nuisance
services.one_line: Report ongoing noise that's affecting your home, like loud music or persistent barking.
services.eligibility: Anyone affected by noise in Meadowvale. Some everyday noise isn't a statutory nuisance.
you_will_need: Details of the noise, times and address
Your contact details — we don't act on anonymous reports
services.fulfilment_detail: Report at https://www.meadowvale.gov.uk/environment/noise. For loud noise happening now at night, call the out-of-hours team on 01000 800 500 (Fri–Sat, 8pm–3am).
what_happens_next: An officer contacts you to open a case
You may be asked to keep a diary or have monitoring installed
